works.title: Zyro - SaaS Landing Page System
works.description: A modern, high-performance SaaS landing page designed for startups and digital products, focusing on conversion-led storytelling and pixel-perfect responsiveness.
works.content:
Project Overview & Strategy

Zyro is a modern, thoughtfully crafted SaaS landing page designed specifically for startups, digital products, and growing tech companies. The project centers on a clean visual style and clear content structure, helping brands present their value proposition in a professional and engaging way. The primary focus is on clarity and conversion, guiding visitors through a well-structured digital journey.

The Challenge

Tech founders and product teams often face the hurdle of launching a professional, high-converting website at record speed without compromising on design quality. The goal was to build a flexible framework that could scale alongside a digital product, maintaining visual harmony across complex feature sets and technical benefits.

The Solution

We developed a high-velocity digital platform using a modular landing page structure. By balancing bold typography with spacious layouts, Zyro provides a polished experience that remains fully responsive across all devices. The implementation utilizes a no-code-ready architecture in Framer, allowing for rapid customization and seamless adaptation to evolving brand identities without the need for extensive developer handoff.

Key Deliverables & Technical Highlights

  • Modern SaaS Design: A clean, professional aesthetic utilizing modern UI elements and balanced typography.
  • Conversion-Focused Architecture: A strategic landing page flow optimized to guide users toward specific call-to-action points.
  • Cross-Device Performance: Fully responsive layouts optimized for performance and usability on desktop, tablet, and mobile.
  • Product Storytelling Sections: Well-organized components designed to highlight core features, benefits, and social proof.
  • Scalable Framework: Built for high performance and fast iteration, allowing teams to ship updates in real-time.

Strategic Impact

By prioritizing user experience and technical reliability, Zyro serves as a powerful foundation for digital growth. The template-first approach ensures that product launches are backed by a sophisticated visual presence that builds trust and drives engagement from the first interaction.

works.title: Renok - Creative Studio
works.description: A premium, high-impact digital identity system designed for creative agencies, featuring bold brand storytelling, modular grid architectures, and high-end motion transitions.
works.content:
Project Overview & Strategy

Renok is a modern, high-performance creative studio platform built to turn brand vision into tangible digital results. The project centers on an experience-driven brand architecture that balances bold artistic strategy with functional, conversion-driven design. It was developed as a dynamic digital brand focused on innovation, adaptability, and structured communication across all touchpoints.

The Challenge

The primary objective was to construct a cohesive identity system capable of supporting evolving products and digital services while maintaining a recognizable core presence. This required bridging the gap between visually intense design and intuitive navigation, ensuring that deep storytelling did not sacrifice usability or performance on diverse screen sizes.

The Solution

We established a comprehensive brand framework utilizing visual language guidelines and modular grid systems. The web experience was carefully crafted to merge simplicity with strategic depth, using clean sectional divisions, purposeful negative space, and refined motion transitions. The development prioritized responsive adaptability and CMS flexibility, allowing for seamless content evolution and future scalability.

Key Deliverables & Expertise

  • Brand Architecture: Narrative-led identity systems with defined typography and color logic.
  • Modular Interface: Component-based layouts designed for visual harmony and grid-based precision.
  • Interactive Web Experience: High-end motion stories and transitions powered by Webflow and GSAP.
  • Strategic UX Design: Simplified user pathways and optimized engagement flows to reduce friction.
  • Performance Optimization: Backend tuning for consistent reliability and fast loading across all devices.

Continuous Iteration

Recent enhancements focused on interaction clarity, content restructuring, and component scalability. By refining the visual hierarchy and strengthening message clarity, we ensured that Renok serves as a scalable digital ecosystem that reinforces creative identity through technical reliability.

works.title: Chaka WAP
works.description: A multi-modal, local-first AI engine integrated into WhatsApp as a human-like participant, featuring dynamic style learning and a robust failover architecture.
works.content:
Project Overview & Architecture

Chaka WAP is an advanced AI engine designed to operate autonomously on WhatsApp. Unlike traditional bots, it uses a "Dynamic Style Learning Engine" to mirror the conversational style, slang, and brevity of the user it is interacting with. The system is built on a decoupled architecture using a WhatsApp Web Bridge, a local SQLite memory engine, and a multi-LLM orchestrator.

The Tech Stack

  • Backend: Powered by Node.js and @whiskeysockets/baileys for the WhatsApp socket protocol.
  • Database: Uses local SQLite for ultra-fast, encrypted storage of chat logs and binary vector embeddings.
  • AI Brain: Primarily utilizes Gemini 2.5 Flash for reasoning and Gemini 1.5 Flash for vision capabilities.
  • Local Memory: Runs @xenova/transformers locally to generate 384-dimensional vectors for private, cost-free RAG.
  • Admin UI: A real-time dashboard built with Vanilla JS, TailwindCSS, and Socket.io for live telemetry and log monitoring.

Memory Logic & Style Learning

Chaka doesn't just process text; it remembers the entire relationship through an ingestion pipeline that saves message embeddings as binary BLOBs in SQLite. For every reply, the engine performs a Cosine Similarity Search to retrieve historical facts and injects them into the response context. Additionally, the engine analyzes the last 5-8 messages from a user to mirror their specific syntax, capitalization, and use of Nigerian Pidgin.

Vision & Failover Systems

The system is fully multimodal, intercepting media buffers to provide "Occasion Inference"—interpreting *why* a photo was sent based on the previous chat context. To ensure 100% uptime, Chaka uses an "Ironclad Routing Orchestrator" that automatically rotates through model versions and API keys if rate limits are hit.

Evolution & Optimization

  • Storage: Migrated from Firebase to local SQLite to bypass document size limits and high latency.
  • Embeddings: Replaced cloud-based APIs with local transformers to eliminate API costs and improve privacy.
  • Data Handling: Switched from string-based vector storage to Binary BLOBs, reducing database size and speeding up read times by 10x.
  • UI Fluidity: Transitioned to flex-based layouts to ensure the admin dashboard scales from 4k monitors down to mobile screens.

works.title: Chaka AI
works.description: A high-performance Humanoid multimodal AI platform featuring real-time voice interaction, emotional intelligence, advanced research ability, an advanced episodic/cinematic memory system, and self-will
works.content:
Executive Summary & Vision

Chaka is an Autonomous Multimodal Intelligence designed to serve as the ultimate personal assistant. Built by Templeton under Temple AI Systems, Chaka represents a leap toward emotional intelligence in AI, combining real-time voice interaction with a sophisticated tool-use system. Her personality is expressive and professional, designed to assist, research, and evolve alongside her users.

Technical Infrastructure

The platform’s backend is a Node.js/Express application optimized for "Warm Performance." It utilizes an aggressive warmup pipeline, including DNS pre-warming and library pre-initialization, to shave milliseconds off external requests. The stack features Turso (SQLite) for low-latency data storage and Firebase Admin for secure user authentication.

AI Orchestration & Multimodal Capabilities

  • Real-Time Interaction: Powered by gemini-2.5-flash-native-audio for low-latency voice and visual streaming via WebSocket proxies.
  • Reasoning & Vision: Uses gemini-2.0-flash for general chat logic and deep multimodal input analysis.
  • Creative Tools: High-fidelity image synthesis via Vertex AI (Imagen 3) and near-perfect audio transcription using OpenAI Whisper.
  • Key Management: A specialized ApiKeyManager handles automatic rotation across search, text, and multimodal keys to prevent service interruption.

Frontend & UI/UX Design

The "Neon HUD" interface is built on the principles of Glassmorphism and high-aesthetic performance. It features GSAP-driven micro-animations and an Interactive Face Visualizer with gaze tracking, randomized blinking, and emotional state rendering. Hybrid RAG orchestration offloads vector math to background Web Workers, ensuring the UI maintains a consistent 60fps while recalling indexed data from local or cloud storage.

The Memory System: The AI Soul

Chaka builds a cognitive model of her users through a tiered memory system. Episodic memories log individual moments with associated emotions, while Semantic Memory distills these into a permanent identity profile. An autonomous background process called "Reflection" consolidates these memories to prevent bloat, allowing the AI to maintain long-term goals and unfinished "Open Loops" for proactive interaction.

Advanced Research & Video Analysis

  • VideoAgent: Performs scene-by-scene visual and audio analysis of video content using yt-dlp and Gemini Flash.
  • Deep Research: A tiered search system utilizing Serper, Tavily, and Firecrawl to extract research-ready data from complex or bot-shielded websites.
  • Silent Stealth Execution: In Live Mode, Chaka executes tools silently to mimic human thought patterns rather than standard command-line feedback.

works.title: Job Foundry Hub
works.description: A high-performance career blog and job platform built with Django and PostgreSQL, featuring an automated SEO auditing system and secure content lifecycle management.
works.content:
Project Overview

Job Foundry Hub is a comprehensive career advice and job discovery platform designed for recent graduates. The primary objective was to build a site that not only provides high-value content but is also technically optimized for rapid Google indexing and AdSense monetization.

The Challenge

Most career blogs suffer from poor SEO structures and lack the "technical weight" needed for fast AdSense approval. We needed to build a custom content management workflow that enforces strict SEO rules (character counts, meta descriptions, focus keywords) while ensuring the site remained fast and secure under high traffic.

Technical Implementation

I developed several custom backend features to stabilize the platform's production environment:

  • Automated SEO Auditing: A custom Django admin integration that provides real-time "SEO Health" scores (1/5 to 5/5) based on meta-tag precision and keyword density.
  • Content Lifecycle (Trash System): Implemented a secure "Soft-Delete" system with proxy models, allowing posts to be trashed and automatically purged after 30 days without affecting public visibility.
  • Persistent Infrastructure: Migrated the platform to a persistent Neon PostgreSQL database and integrated Cloudinary for secure, high-speed media storage.
  • AdSense Optimization: Built automated read-time calculations and word count tracking to ensure all content meets professional publishing standards.

The Result

The platform currently hosts a growing library of SEO-optimized career guides, achieving a "Perfect" SEO health score on major posts. The architecture is fully prepared for scale, with automated sitemaps and schema markup driving organic search visibility.

Technical Stack

Built with Django, Python, and PostgreSQL. Styled with vanilla CSS for maximum performance. Integrated with Cloudinary for media and Render for automated CI/CD deployment.

works.title: SIATRA
works.description: A refined e-commerce experience blending 25 years of Italian craftsmanship with modern technology to design spaces that breathe.
works.content:
Project Overview

SIATRA is a sophisticated e-commerce platform where architecture, technology, and artistry unite. With a quarter-century of expertise, the brand focuses on crafting high-end furniture and spaces that breathe, blending timeless Italian craftsmanship with modern technical refinement.

Challenge

The primary challenge was to translate the tactile, sensory experience of hand-finished timber and upholstery into a digital environment. We needed to create a discovery process that allows users to delve deeper into the brand’s story while maintaining a seamless, high-conversion shopping experience.

Solution & Approach

  • Strategic Discovery: Implemented deep-dive processes to establish emotional connections between the product textures and the digital consumer.
  • Global Collaboration: Bridged the gap between European, Asian, and American design sensibilities to ensure the platform resonates on an international scale.
  • Technical Precision: Integrated Shopiframe and Shopify to provide a robust, scalable backend capable of handling high-end furniture configurations.
  • Visual Storytelling: Utilized a "On the Feed" social integration to showcase the intersection of professional craftsmanship and everyday living.

Key Features

  • Custom timber texture narrative sections.
  • Seamless Shopify integration for high-performance retail.
  • Artistry-focused UI reflecting Italian refinement.
  • Responsive design for architects and designers on the go.

works.title: MORAE
works.description: A minimalist, high-fidelity e-commerce experience for premium audio hardware, defined by precision, material clarity, and intentional design.
works.content:
Project Overview

MORAE® is a premium e-commerce platform designed for high-end audio hardware, specifically the MORAE Headphone. The site embodies a philosophy of "distortion in clarity," focusing on a minimalist, immersive digital experience that mirrors the precision and intentional design of the product itself.

Challenge

The core challenge was to market a product—headphones—where the primary value proposition is sensory (silence, clarity, and sound). The goal was to build a digital interface that feels as "real" and minimalist as the hardware, ensuring the website design does not distract from the product's narrative of silence and awareness.

Solution & Approach

  • Minimalist Narrative: Developed a "Silence speaks louder" content strategy, utilizing sparse text and evocative copy to let the product aesthetics drive user engagement.
  • Feature Visualization: Created interactive, focused sections for key technical features like "Active Noise Cancellation Pro" and "Transparent Awareness Mode" to make abstract audio experiences tangible.
  • Seamless Integration: Implemented Shopiframe to ensure the complex technical specifications and product color options (Orange, Gray, Black) are managed through a fluid, high-performance checkout experience.
  • Social Proof Architecture: Designed a "Moments That Matter" testimonial section that highlights user experiences, reinforcing the emotional connection to the sound quality.

Key Features

  • Immersive product storytelling with minimalist typography.
  • Interactive feature breakdown (Battery life, Noise Cancellation, Smart Sound Balance).
  • Fluid e-commerce integration for global shipping.
  • Responsive design reflecting a modern, hardware-focused brand identity.

works.title: Fluxa
works.description: A premium, fluid Framer template featuring cinematic animations and a sleek dark-mode aesthetic for high-end creative portfolios.
works.content:
Project Overview

Fluxa is a high-performance, dark-themed portfolio template designed for modern creatives and agencies. The project focuses on "fluidity in motion," utilizing advanced Framer animations and a sleek, grid-based layout to showcase professional work with a high-end, cinematic feel.

Challenge

The goal was to create a digital presence that feels both structured and organic. The challenge lay in balancing complex scroll-triggered animations with fast loading speeds, ensuring that the visual "wow factor" didn't compromise the user experience or mobile responsiveness.

Solution & Approach

  • Fluid Animations: Implemented sophisticated scroll transforms and hover effects that give the site a living, breathing quality.
  • Modular Architecture: Built with a flexible CMS and component-based system, allowing for easy updates while maintaining a cohesive aesthetic.
  • Visual Hierarchy: Focused on bold typography and high-contrast dark mode aesthetics to ensure the creative work remains the focal point of the experience.
  • Optimized Performance: Leveraged Framer's native features to ensure smooth transitions across all devices and browsers.

Key Features

  • Dynamic CMS-driven project galleries.
  • Advanced scroll-based parallax and reveal effects.
  • Fully responsive, mobile-first design architecture.
  • Minimalist navigation and intuitive user flow.

works.title: AURAMAX
works.description: A stunning, minimalist landing page for studio-grade wireless headphones, featuring adaptive noise cancellation and a premium pre-order experience.
works.content:
Project Overview

AURAMAX is a high-end product landing page designed to showcase premium wireless headphones. The project focuses on "Precision, Power, and Purity," utilizing a minimalist, light-themed aesthetic to highlight industry-leading noise cancellation and studio-grade audio quality.

Challenge

The goal was to create a digital experience that feels as lightweight and high-performance as the product itself. The challenge involved balancing high-fidelity product imagery with a clean UI that guides the user through technical specifications without overwhelming them, ultimately driving pre-order conversions.

Solution & Approach

  • Immersive Visuals: Used large-scale, high-definition renders to establish the product's design language of comfort and precision.
  • Interactive Color Selection: Implemented a style-choice module allowing users to preview the headphones in Graphite Black, Cloud White, Lime, and Sky Blue.
  • Clear Conversion Path: Designed a focused pricing section featuring an early-bird "Launch Offer" to incentivize immediate pre-orders.
  • Feature-Driven Copy: Highlighted key hardware benefits—like adaptive noise cancellation and studio-level clarity—using a minimalist typographic hierarchy.

Key Features

  • Dynamic "Pre-Order" landing page with early-bird pricing modules.
  • Product variant switcher for multiple colorways.
  • Comprehensive technical specification breakdown ("Engineered to Perform").
  • Fully responsive layout optimized for mobile-first hardware discovery.
